mapper.sql: SELECT t.*, COALESCE(c.name, s.name) AS partner_name, a.name AS account_name, v.voucher_no, u.nickname AS create_by_name, ad.advance_no FROM fin_settlement t LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON t.kind = 'RECEIPT' AND c.id = t.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON t.kind = 'PAYMENT' AND s.id = t.partner_id LEFT JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = t.voucher_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.create_by LEFT JOIN fin_advance ad ON ad.id = t.advance_id
